key_claims: Aging individuals often experience difficulty remembering recent events or what they intended to say next.
People frequently lose or misplace objects as they age.
Standard cognitive tests can detect memory impairments in some cases.
Some individuals notice and report a memory decline even when their cognitive test scores are in the normal range.
limitations: The summary provides general context on memory complaints but contains no details on study methods, sample size, or specific research findings.
The provided text does not explain the brain imaging techniques or the shared memory network mentioned in the title.
what_not_to_say: Do not claim specific brain imaging modalities, brain regions, or neural networks were identified, as the provided text lacks these details.

Do not include medical advice or specific treatment options for memory loss.
